hauskaFactory.contradicted: The mission's premise ('setback-table-router.mjs ... carries the rule locally because it could not import the engine's module' -> 'the local rule is deleted with a retirement test') does not hold. Read setback-table-router.mjs in full: it has EXACTLY ONE candidate ever (the corpus's single codified table via corpusGetSetbackTable) -- its own docstring already says so explicitly ('this writer has exactly ONE candidate ... it never compares sources, so there is nothing for hauska-engine's resolveMostCurrentSetback to resolve BETWEEN here'). PR #141 (ba15fee5, wave 3) only added sourceDate/dateBasis VOCABULARY fields for cross-surface comparability, not a duplicate R-1 algorithm. There is no local rule to delete. Bumping the @empressaio/setback-corpus dependency to ^1.2.0 (harmless on its own) is coupled through the shared CORPUS_VERSION string constant to an OUT-OF-SCOPE envelope program guard (envelope-corpus-lookup.mjs throws at import time if not-specified-classification-table.json's own corpusVersion field, an OPS-21-R1/P-146-generated artifact, does not match) -- bumping one without the other would crash the envelope-cells job. Did not touch either file; flagged in leave_behind for the owning lane. No PR opened for hauska-factory; nothing genuinely needed changing for the P-154 sharing goal.
